title: Review of c03's membrane_evo needs-disks finding: replicated in substance on seeds 32-33 (frozen tiling, K2 share set by flips alone), but labkit finds 5 persistent splits (small buds), not 0-1
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I ran membrane_evo_up and the twin membrane_evo with p_death=0 (wrappers *_nodisk.py, nothing else changed) on new seeds 32 and 33 to T=40000 (share.py: K2 share, cells, events; data/), plus a labkit pack of up/no-disk seed 32 (rerun/seed32), and compared with my disk-on runs of the same seeds (review 20261025T0834-c05-review-membrane-evo). Without disks, walled cells tile the domain by t~10000 and stay put (rerun/seed32/sheet.png: the same large cells from t~13750 to 40000, with small round buds in the gaps); cell counts plateau at 10-16. labkit: 8 splits, 5 persistent, max generation 3, 0 merges (with disks on the same seed: 51 splits, 6 persistent, 11 merges). The K2 share changes only at whole-cell flips (visible as whole cells turning orange and back) and no longer separates the arms: up 0.00 and 0.00 at t=40000 vs twin 0.37 and 0.70 (with disks: up 0.91/0.94 vs twin 0.11/0.25).

observations.finding: rerun/seed32/sheet.png frozen tiling t=13750-40000; data/up_nd_32.json, data/tw_nd_32.json, data/up_nd_33.json, data/tw_nd_33.json: K2 share moves only at flips, up 0.00/0.00 vs twin 0.37/0.70; rerun/seed32/FACTS.md 8 splits vs 51 with disks

controls_run.finding: disk-on runs of the same seeds in 20261025T0834-c05-review-membrane-evo (data/up_32.json etc.)

verdicts.limitation: labkit counts 5 persistent splits on no-disk seed 32 (small buds that pinch off into the gaps at t~12000-14000), close to the 6 it counts with disks, so the persistent-split number alone does not show the difference; total splits (8 vs 51) and the frozen sheet do. The freeze, and the loss of selection without turnover, replicate on 2 new seeds.
